correctness.rationale: For every nonempty proper S the expectation is exactly p_c(2p(S))^d. Covariances vanish beyond center distance 2 and obey the displayed uniform short-distance bound, giving the noncritical trichotomy by Markov and Chebyshev. For every critical indicator, its marginal is p_c2^{-d}; direct overlap counts bound b1≤m²D_d2^{-d}, b2≤m²ρ^d+4m²D_d2^{-d} with b3=0. AGG1989 Theorem 2 supplies joint point-process total variation ≤4(b1+b2); coordinate summation yields the precise claimed independence and rate. Fixed Boolean threshold evaluation follows by mapping convergence. Exact finite-pair and small-model enumerations pass, and are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single rare local-star event is not the central result. The joint theorem resolves the dependence structure of all simultaneously critical local color tests, with explicit total-variation error and a sharp mass threshold for every test. It gives a complete probability evaluation procedure for the Boolean closure of a natural fixed first-order star-count fragment and a striking parity transition for uniform palettes. These are structural results concerning the actual logical model, beyond a numerical constant or routine marginal count.
